facts.text: The Great South Shore Railroad Train Wreck of June 19, 1909 was the worst accident on the South Shore line, striking the Shadyside neighborhood of historic Burns Harbor.
Burns Harbor takes its name from a local port promoted by Randall W., whose vision helped shape the town’s early maritime activity.
The town of Burns Harbor was officially founded in 1966, making it one of the newest communities in Porter County.
Burns Harbor borders the Indiana Dunes, an area that conservationists have fought hard to preserve for its unique sand dunes and wildlife.
Swedish immigrants settled in Baillytown, a historic district of Burns Harbor, where their influence helped shape the local culture and architecture.
